issues.issue: Does the Court have appellate jurisdiction over the Minister's appeal of an interlocutory stay order made on a pending leave application?
issues.applicant_position: Minister says section 27 of the Federal Courts Act gives appellate jurisdiction, and the stay order was made outside statutory jurisdiction.
issues.result_quote: We are all of the view that paragraph 72(2)(e) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act precludes this Court from entertaining the Minister's appeal.

issues.issue: Were the terms of the stay order (external matters, duration, usurping the Minister's humanitarian powers) errors of law?
issues.applicant_position: Stay order discloses several errors of law: external matters, duration past the leave decision, and usurping the Minister's humanitarian authority.
issues.result_quote: It would not be appropriate to express an opinion on any of these issues
